number.description: Lecture/lab/homework number. Defaults to the digits the file name opens with.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences shown in lists.

sources.description: Files under source/ this was written from, e.g. `lectures/L05.pdf`.

status.description: `draft` is shown as a label; the page is still visible.
